project_overview.description: A Node.js based agent system for tracking and managing tasks in Notion via the Notion API
project_overview.purpose: Enable automated task creation, status updates, and tracking in a Notion database
project_overview.scope: Core task management operations with Notion API integration

completed_features: createTask() function with title, assignedTo, notes parameters
updateTask() function with status and notes update capability
Example usage demonstration in main() function
current_limitations: Limited assignee functionality (people field not utilized)
No pagination handling for large datasets

FR-001.details: Create tasks in Notion with title, assignee, and notes

FR-002.details: Update task status and notes in Notion

FR-003.details: Query and retrieve tasks from Notion database

FR-004.details: Delete or archive tasks from Notion

FR-005.details: Search tasks by various criteria (status, assignee, date)

FR-007.details: Validate all inputs before API calls

NFR-001.details: Comprehensive error handling with retry logic

ambiguous_requirements.question: Should the 'Assigned To' field use Notion user IDs, emails, or display names?
ambiguous_requirements.current_state: Currently passes empty array for people field

ambiguous_requirements.question: What are all valid status values? (Currently only 'To-do' and 'Done' are used)
Is the Notion database schema fixed or should the code adapt to different schemas?
ambiguous_requirements.current_state: Hardcoded field names (Task, Assigned To, Status, Notes, ID)

ambiguous_requirements.question: Should the ID field be auto-generated by Notion or managed by the application?
ambiguous_requirements.impact: Affects task creation and retrieval logic
ambiguous_requirements.current_state: Currently set to null, relying on Notion auto-increment

ambiguous_requirements.question: Should this run as a long-running service, scheduled cron job, or on-demand CLI tool?

risks_and_constraints.description: Notion API rate limits may restrict high-volume operations
risks_and_constraints.mitigation: Implement rate limiting and exponential backoff

risks_and_constraints.description: Invalid database ID or API key causes all operations to fail
Database schema changes could break the application
risks_and_constraints.mitigation: Implement schema validation and flexible field mapping
